title: Svedala Kommun
description: svedala.se Revenue $282.1 Million Svedala kommun is a municipality in Skåne County, Sweden, part of Greater Malmö with 23,722 residents and a projected growth to 26,800 by 2032. It jumped from 63rd to 15th place in Sweden's Bäst att leva 2026 ranking, ranking number one nationwide in business climate, self-sufficiency and outbound commuting. The local economy centers on transport and warehousing driven by Malmö Airport, with Sandvik SRP as the largest private employer and a new Airport City MMX business park planned to create 1,000 jobs. The municipality runs a balanced budget of SEK 1.66 billion with a tax rate below the national average. Education performs above average with 89.8 percent gymnasium eligibility and 80.3 percent qualified teachers. It is investing 431 million kronor in infrastructure 2025 to 2027.
